llm_response.reason: The site uses a brand name ('Adalberto Donate') not associated with the legitimate Tretorn company, misleads users by selling brand products it is not officially authorized to sell, and features several psychological ploys (unwarranted assurances of safety, free shipping offers). External sources—Facebook and YouTube—flag the site as a scam, with users reporting negative experiences and warnings. The site mimics a legitimate e-commerce structure but lacks any authenticating company information, fitting key characteristics of scam websites including impersonation, psychological manipulation, and false company details.
